title: How do we fill the empty tiles of the three grids?
description: Three hollow grids have some tiles filled and a border sum given. For each empty tile the numbers already known on its side are added first, then the move needed to reach the border sum gives the missing number. One working filling is built for each grid and every side is checked.
teaching_notes: One idea: the missing number on a side is the move needed from the total so far to the border sum. Watch for students who forget the minus sign when the move goes down, or who think each grid has only one correct filling.

video_script.why: The child completes three hollow grids to reach a given border sum by finding each missing number from the numbers already on its side.
video_script.substitution: The book's own three grids with their given numbers, filled in the way the book shows.
video_script.anchor: a square of nine tiles from the book, with the middle tile missing
video_script.payoff_line: Each empty tile is the number that moves the total so far to the border sum.

final_answer.value: Grid A: top row -10, 10, 4; middle row 5, empty, -5; bottom row 9, -10, 5. Grid B: top row 6, 8, -16; middle row 11, empty, -5; bottom row -19, -2, 19. Grid C: top row 7, -2, -9; middle row -3, empty, -5; bottom row -8, -6, 10.
final_answer.spoken: the three grids are filled so that every side reaches the border sum

hold_back: Grid A: top row -10, 10, 4; middle row 5, empty, -5; bottom row 9, -10, 5.
maths_rules: add one number at a time: a plus number moves up, a minus number moves down
missing number on a side = border sum minus the total of the known numbers on that side

grid A, border sum 4, given -10 top left, -5 middle right, 9 bottom left: left column -10 + 5 + 9 = 4; choose top right 4; top row -10 + 10 + 4 = 4; right column 4 + (-5) + 5 = 4; bottom row 9 + (-10) + 5 = 4

grid B, border sum -2, given 6 top left, 8 top middle, -5 middle right, -2 bottom middle: top row 6 + 8 + (-16) = -2; right column -16 + (-5) + 19 = -2; bottom row -19 + (-2) + 19 = -2; left column 6 + 11 + (-19) = -2

grid C, border sum -4, given 7 top left, -5 middle right: choose top right -9; top row 7 + (-2) + (-9) = -4; right column -9 + (-5) + 10 = -4; choose middle left -3; left column 7 + (-3) + (-8) = -4; bottom row -8 + (-6) + 10 = -4
grids A and C leave free choices, so other fillings also work; the book shows one way for each
video_script.design: Each grid in turn with its given tiles. For every empty tile the side is lit, the total so far is shown on the upright number line, and an arrow shows the move up or down to the border sum.
open_questions: The book shows one way for each grid and says to think of other ways, so the video builds the book's filling and says other fillings also work.
